integrity: Exact universal proof and finite independently generated test instances are supplied. Finite tests are consistency checks, not a proof of untested parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified constacyclic action on q-ary Hamming codes for prime-power q and redundancy r >= 2. Total unrefined orbit counts are prior art. This does not solve optimal covering sequences or imply independent priority certification.
title: Complete period–weight orbit spectrum of constacyclic Hamming codes
